query_form: P(Q1 | comparable generated-subject properties, historical/source scope)
conditioning_dimensions: Any exact actor property set lawfully mapped to one empirical predicate
respondent_incidence_required: NO for a fixed already-built exact contingency; YES or information-equivalent if the conditioner is selected later
exact_contingency_sufficient: YES for the exact bounded query
weighting_required: YES where a governed population measure uses weights; otherwise weight state must be typed
loss_if_absent: Cannot distinguish the target response distribution for the comparator cohort; fallback to population marginal fabricates equivalence

query_form: P(Q1 | P1=a AND P2=b AND ... AND Pm=m, scope)
respondent_incidence_required: YES or an exact information-equivalent contingency covering the conjunction
unary_sufficient: NO; separate one-property marginals cannot recover intersections
weighting_required: YES where governed; exact weight identity and basis required
loss_if_absent: Independent or marginal reconstruction can erase interactions, Simpson reversals, or zero-support intersections

pairwise_sufficient: YES only when 'pairwise' means the complete Q1×Q2 contingency for this exact bounded two-variable target, not a scalar association
unary_sufficient: NO unless exact mutual conditional independence is separately proven
loss_if_absent: Impossible or absent combinations can be fabricated by independent unary draws

respondent_incidence_required: YES or exact k-way conditional contingency/information-equivalent factorization
exact_contingency_sufficient: YES for the exact bounded k-way query
loss_if_absent: Higher-order dependence, contradiction, and parity structure can disappear while every unary/pairwise view stays unchanged
Even and odd parity worlds can have identical 1-, 2-, and 3-way marginals but disjoint 4-way support

conditioning_dimensions: One exact shared conditioner C and one exact shared risk-set/source/measure semantics
respondent_incidence_required: NO if exact mutual conditional-independence authority and all factor tables are already present; otherwise YES/information-equivalent
exact_contingency_sufficient: YES via exact factors only when factorization is proven for every lawful configuration
unary_sufficient: YES only under exact mutual conditional independence, common risk set, common measure, topology compatibility, and exact support factorization
loss_if_absent: Without exact factorization proof, product sampling assigns mass to empirically absent configurations or erases dependence

query_form: All P(Qi,Qj | C) but no k-way relation for k>2
respondent_incidence_required: YES to reconstruct missing k-way facts unless another exact factorization is proven
loss_if_absent: XOR/parity and other higher-order interactions are invisible

query_form: Sparse list of every nonzero configuration plus exact denominator and explicit zero-state semantics for a fixed target
respondent_incidence_required: NO for that fixed query if exhaustiveness is proven; YES for later reconditioning/new target variables
pairwise_sufficient: YES only for k=2; otherwise the sparse object itself must be k-way
loss_if_absent: If exhaustive, no loss for the bounded query; if zeros/exhaustiveness are unknown, omitted minority states are ambiguous

respondent_incidence_required: YES or another deeper source needed to recover deleted configurations
loss_if_absent: Minority and multimodal configurations are erased and omitted cannot be distinguished from observed zero

query_form: Generate P(T | C,S,R) after target/condition selection
conditioning_dimensions: Any later-authorized empirical predicate produced from a lawful generated-subject comparator
respondent_incidence_required: YES in semantic capability terms, or a relation information-equivalent for the entire authorized frontier
loss_if_absent: Without respondent-bound or equivalent incidence, later conjunctions/reconditioning cannot be formed without independence assumptions

query_form: P(Q1,...,Qk | C) where one or more questions have routing/applicability states
conditioning_dimensions: Exact comparable actor-property predicate plus governed routing/eligibility predicate
respondent_incidence_required: YES or exact contingency preserving routing/applicability states
exact_contingency_sufficient: YES when routing/risk-set semantics are included
unary_sufficient: NO as a substitute for joint targets
loss_if_absent: Dropping routed respondents or converting not-asked to an answer changes denominator and invents empirical content

query_form: P(T | C) with raw denominator N(C,R,S)=0
conditioning_dimensions: Exact comparator predicate with no observed eligible respondents
respondent_incidence_required: NO additional incidence can create evidence; the zero denominator itself must be proven from an exhaustive governed risk set
exact_contingency_sufficient: YES to establish zero denominator for the bounded query
loss_if_absent: Returning a normalized distribution, fallback marginal, or all-zero 'probabilities' fabricates evidence

query_form: P(T=z | C) with positive but small support
respondent_incidence_required: NO for fixed exact contingency; YES for later reconditioning
support_required: YES; raw and weighted positive support must survive
loss_if_absent: Thresholding can convert low prevalence into impossibility and delete real minority configurations

query_form: Attempt P(Q1,Q2 | C) from questions/sources that cannot be bound to the same respondents under one lawful scope
respondent_incidence_required: YES for a genuine joint; if no lawful binder exists the joint is unavailable
exact_contingency_sufficient: NO cross-universe contingency may be synthesized from marginals
loss_if_absent: A false join or naive pooling manufactures cotravel that was never observed

query_form: {P(T | C,S1), P(T | C,S2), ...} with source disagreement preserved
conditioning_dimensions: Same comparator semantics only where lawful in each source universe
respondent_incidence_required: Per-source incidence or exact per-source contingency
loss_if_absent: Pooling can hide source disagreement, double-count populations, or imply cross-source comparability that is unproved

query_form: P(Q1,...,Qk | comparable properties AND prior response configuration X=x, scope)
conditioning_dimensions: Actor property comparator plus an explicitly authorized response-semantic comparator
respondent_incidence_required: YES or exact higher-order contingency containing X and targets
exact_contingency_sufficient: YES for the fixed full query
loss_if_absent: Without joint incidence, conditioning on prior response is replaced by an independence approximation

query_form: P(T | C, source/wave/time scope) with generated subject evaluated against a historically dated survey universe
conditioning_dimensions: Comparable actor properties plus exact survey time/source scope
loss_if_absent: Ignoring temporal comparability can apply a historically distant response field as if contemporaneous; unresolved comparison must remain typed

query_form: For each configuration z return support/mass plus typed uncertainty basis rather than false certainty
respondent_incidence_required: No additional respondent identity if exact counts/design basis are already present
exact_contingency_sufficient: YES for support uncertainty; numeric sampling interval additionally requires whatever governed survey-design information the authorized estimator needs
weighting_required: YES where governed; missing weight/design authority must remain explicit
loss_if_absent: A probability without support/denominator/design state can masquerade as precise actor propensity
